## PDFAR - Advanced PDF Reader

A lightweight PDF reader with advanced search (AND/OR/phrase), page navigation, highlighting, smooth scrolling, flexible zoom, and lazy loading for large documents. Built with PyQt6 and PyMuPDF. Multi-language support (English, Spanish).

Topics: pdf-reader, pdf-viewer, qt6, python, linux, document-viewer, pymupdf, advanced-search, pdf-processing
